Do I need Primavera installed?

No. Export .XER or .XML from P6 once; Schedulytics reads the file on any Windows PC.

Does my schedule leave my computer?

No. All processing happens locally — nothing is uploaded, during the trial or after.

What does the trial include?

The full app for 30 days. Outputs carry a watermark until you activate a licence key.

Is it a subscription?

No. One payment, a perpetual licence for two devices. Prices in USD; Android versions are in testing.
